params._maxPotTotal: Maximum target allowed per pot in USDC units (6 dec).
params._treasury: Address that receives protocol fees and swept tokens.                    MUST be a non-blocklisted address on the deployment chain                    (e.g., a plain EOA or a contract that accepts USDC transfers).                    If treasury becomes blocklisted after deployment, fee-bearing                    claimPayout calls will revert; all contributors can still                    withdraw their contributions once isRefundable returns true.
params._usdc: Address of the USDC ERC-20 (must have code).

cancel(uint256).notice: Creator cancels an OPEN pot; contributors may then withdraw.

claimDeadline(uint256).notice: Unix timestamp at which the claim window closes.         Returns filledAt + CLAIM_WINDOW for FILLED and PAID pots; 0 otherwise.

claimPayout(uint256).notice: Anyone may trigger payout once the pot is FILLED and within         the claim window. Funds always go to the pot's recipient.

createPot(address,uint256,uint256,uint25.notice: Create a new flexible group pot.

deposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Contribute `amount` USDC toward pot `potId`.         The contract accepts at most (target - raised); any excess is         never pulled from the caller.

isRefundable(uint256).notice: True when a contributor may call withdraw on this pot.         True if status != PAID and (OPEN, CANCELLED, or FILLED after claim window).

remaining(uint256).notice: How much USDC still needs to be raised for pot `potId`.

sweepUnaccounted().notice: Sweep any USDC balance above totalLocked to the treasury.

withdraw(uint256,uint256).notice: Withdraw `amount` from the caller's own contribution.         Allowed when isRefundable; never after PAID.
